Create a premium HAVENLINE sculpted 3D game-asset reference sheet. Match the supplied Havenline style reference: confident chunky silhouettes, broad clean bevels, subtly carved warm timber, convincing blue or dark steel, bronze fasteners where the source shows them, pale stone and selective clean snow on exposed ledges. Keep source-specific roof, canvas, glass and metal colors. Use refined animated-feature/PBR-like rendering, soft studio illumination, crisp useful detail, and quiet contact shadows. Use a pale warm-gray studio background, generous gutters and complete uncropped objects. Avoid photoreal grime, painterly noise, glossy toy-plastic flattening, extra characters, decorative piles, fake UI, promotional badges, and crowded copied-board graphics. This is deliberate production reference art with clear geometry and a small clean sans-serif heading.

REFERENCES IN ACTUAL ORDER
Reference 1: 18607.png — Original user early-camp board; object identity and source-visible forms.
Reference 2: 18609.png — Original user mid-camp board; object identity and source-visible forms.
Reference 3: defense-platform-turnaround-r2.png — Reviewed Havenline material and rendering style ONLY: broad sculpted bevels, warm timber, blue steel, restrained snow, pale studio background. Do not copy the defense platform geometry.

SUBJECT: DOG KENNEL UPGRADES.
Render DOG KENNEL from 18607 lower building row and the larger KENNEL LEVEL 2 from 18609 second row. Preserve the compact blue-gabled open-arch dog house with its source bowl, then the more substantial blue-roof timber kennel building with its source door/frontage. Keep canine-scale shelter proportions and fixed bowl/door placement. No dog is needed, and no additional companion design or breeding/training mechanic should be invented. Source labels may distinguish BASIC KENNEL and IMPROVED KENNEL without adding any new level schedule.

SOURCE ANCHORS
- 18607.png: Dog kennel (LVL1); lower building row
- 18609.png: Kennel level2; second row

SHEET
Small heading: HAVENLINE | DOG KENNEL UPGRADES. Requested landscape canvas 1536 × 1024, with detail large enough to judge. Four large panels in a 2-column by 2-row landscape sheet. For a two-form sheet each row is one form: front-left then rear-right. For a single-form sheet the top row is the opposing exterior pair and the bottom row is the two specified detail/use views.
Required panels:
- BASIC KENNEL / FRONT-LEFT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- BASIC KENNEL / REAR-RIGHT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- IMPROVED KENNEL / FRONT-LEFT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- IMPROVED KENNEL / REAR-RIGHT: Opposing geometry and identity reference

The two opposing three-quarter views of a form must show ONE fixed design from front-left and rear-right; rotate the camera around it, do not mirror the image. Keep doors, windows, chimneys, pipe runs, roof pitch, support posts, snow patches, planks, handles, annexes and material assignments in the same physical positions. Preserve the distinct source silhouettes; do not make variants by recoloring one duplicated model. The source boards mostly show one side, so rear faces and any opened interiors are restrained concept interpretations. Add the short footer SOURCE-BASED CONCEPT · UNSEEN SURFACES INTERPRETED. Do not print invented levels, costs, capacities, rates, recipes, unlocks, dimensions or gameplay claims. Source-visible props remain aesthetic context; no new production chain, crop list, animal drop, weapon mechanism or runtime behavior is established.
